contract.selective_unregister: Unregister removes only the listener entry owned by the specified plugin
contract.ownership_isolation: Removing one owner does not remove another owner using the same callback
contract.remaining_owner_preservation: The remaining owner stays registered with the shared callback
contract.delivery_continuity: The remaining owner continues receiving events after selective unregister
contract.removed_owner_isolation: The removed owner no longer receives subsequent events
contract.registry_stability: Selective unregister preserves the remaining listener registry
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful after selective multi-owner unregister
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration, unregister, and emit operations require the events permission
